A large '''house''' was located in a medium-sized [[Waywa Fybot's hometown|town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> [[Uaua/Legends|Uaua]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The house was built out of [[Cement/Legends|cement]] and [[Steel/Legends|steel]] beams and had a thatched roof and a [[Color/Legends|magenta]]-colored [[Grass/Legends|lawn]] enclosed by a fence.<ref name="LCFO" /> The [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]]<ref name="CSWE Fybot">{{CSWECite|I|300|Fybot, Waywa}}</ref> [[Waywa Fybot]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|hatched]] in the house and once visited the building in a [[Dream/Legends|dream]].<ref name="LCFO" />
